system.longDesc:
Cost: 1–5 SP

NOTE: You may only choose stunts from this list when you earn the SP while making an attack with a gun. Some gun stunts require a specific type of gun, such as a pistol, rifle, or automatic weapon.

At the end of each character’s turn until the start of your next turn (including allies and your current target), make a new attack against that character if they’re within (SP) meters of the spot where your target stands right now.
